paite: Huan Moab Phaizang a pan Jeriko zawn a Nebo tang, Pisgah tang vum ah Mosi ahohtou a; TOUPA'N Gilead gam tengteng, Dan pha in a-ensak hi.
heading: Mosi Sihna
english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

paite: Naphtali leh Ephraim gam tengteng, Manasseh leh Judia gam tengteng, atumlam tuipi pha in.
english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

paite: Sim gam leh tum khopi Jeriko Phaizang, Zoar pha in.
english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Hiai gam ahi Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a, 'Na suante ka pe ding,' chi a kichiam a ka na chiam. Muh ahihleh ka hon musak peuhmah a, himahleh huai ah na pai kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA sikha Mosi, TOUPA thu bang in Moab gam ah asita hi.
heading: Mosi Sihna Leh Vuina
english: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Beth-peor zawn a Moab gam phaizang ah avui a; himahleh tuni tan in kuamah in ahan athei kei uh.
english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

paite: Mosi asih in kum za-le-sawmnih a upa ahi; amit amial kei a, atha leng akiam tuan kei hi.
english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

paite: Israel suante'n Moab Phaizang ah ni sawmthum Mosi akah ua, huchi in Mosi suun a, akah nite uh hong beita hi.
english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

paite: Mosi in atung a, akhut akoih ziak in Nun tapa Joshua pilna kha in adim a; Israel suante'n athu azui ua, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahih uhi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huai nung in Israelte lak ah Mosi bang a TOUPA'N kimaituah a ahoupih zawlnei himhim a-omta kei;
heading: Mosi Thilhihte
english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,

paite: chiamtehna leh thillamdang tengteng, Pharaoh leh asikha tengteng kiang leh Aigupta gam tengteng a-ensak a,
english: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

paite: khut hattak leh lauhuai pipi a Israel mi teng mitmuh a Mosi in ahih bang hih a-om kei uhi.
english: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
